{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meat Recipes|Meat Recipes]]

This is a simple '''sweet-and-sour sauce''' that works well as an everyday meal, even with leftover meat. It is best served with [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]], and perhaps also [[Cookbook:Steaming|steamed]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable|vegetables]]. The [[Cookbook:Sauce|sauce]] alone (no [[Cookbook:Meat|meat]], [[Cookbook:Cherry|cherries]], or [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]] chunks) can be poured over rice or used as a dip for [[Cookbook:Egg Roll|egg rolls]].

==Ingredients==

* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* ⅓ cup red wine [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 1 can (20 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 567 [[Cookbook:g|g]]) [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]] chunks in unsweetened juice
* [[Cookbook:Maraschino Cherry|Maraschino cherries]]
* [[Cookbook:Celery|Celery]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* Cooked meat (suggested: [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] or [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]]) or fish (optional)
* Cooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]

==Procedure==

#Mix the brown sugar and corn starch in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
#Add the vinegar, soy sauce, and most of the pineapple juice
#Heat to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] while stirring constantly.
#Reduce heat, then add pineapple chunks, cherries, celery, and cooked meat.
#Cook until celery begins to soften.
#Serve sauce with cooked rice.
